# A synthetic filesystem corpus with the SHAPE of a real compositor morning.
#
# Read by internal/fsobserve/fixturecorpus_test.go, built into a temporary
# directory by internal/fsfixture. Format: path | birth | mtime, with the mtime
# omitted where the file was written once and never touched again.
#
# NOTHING HERE IS REAL. Every name is invented and the date, 2026-03-04, is
# deliberately not any day this project has published a figure about, so that a
# number measured off this corpus can never be mistaken for a measurement of
# somebody's actual working day. What IS carried across from the real morning
# realdata_test.go asserts against is the arithmetic between the two stamps on
# each file, because that arithmetic is the whole subject of this package.
#
# Reproduce the real figures this was modelled on with:
#   stat -f "%SB %Sm" -t "%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M:%S" <the directory realdata_test.go names>

# Saved at the start of the session and again at its end: two events, 50 minutes
# apart, and the only file in the corpus that spans the whole morning.
studio/beacon2-face-granted.motn | 2026-03-04 06:00:14.913427472 | 2026-03-04 06:50:34.742495669

# Born in the same gesture as the file above and then touched again the NEXT
# DAY. Its mtime says nothing whatever about this morning; without the birth
# time, the whole of its contribution to 06:00 disappears. This is the case the
# package exists for.
studio/beacon3-face-granted.motn | 2026-03-04 06:00:14.913427472 | 2026-03-05 13:17:56.000000000

# Written once. Birth and mtime differ by scheduling jitter alone — 185ms, 124µs,
# 170µs, 51ms — and every one of them stays inside a single Unix second, so each
# file is one event rather than two.
studio/panel2.af             | 2026-03-04 06:41:36.799256773 | 2026-03-04 06:41:36.984793537
studio/big-x-2.png           | 2026-03-04 06:42:13.515838756 | 2026-03-04 06:42:13.515962377
studio/big-check-2.png       | 2026-03-04 06:42:24.305116437 | 2026-03-04 06:42:24.305286806
studio/big-check-green-2.png | 2026-03-04 06:48:09.154229300 | 2026-03-04 06:48:09.205948420

# The counter-case, and the reason coincidence is judged at Unix() resolution
# rather than by elapsed time: 657.8ms apart, which is LESS than a second, and
# yet in two different seconds. Two writes, two events.
studio/big-x-red-2.png | 2026-03-04 06:43:11.536758418 | 2026-03-04 06:43:12.194606109

# The same file again inside a nested worktree. A project directory can hold
# copies of itself, and one measured case in this project was 86x inflated by
# exactly this — 6103 raw files against 71 once worktree copies were excluded.
# Counting it would double every figure above.
.claude/worktrees/agent-1/studio/beacon2-face-granted.motn | 2026-03-04 06:00:14.913427472 | 2026-03-04 06:50:34.742495669

# One of each kind of file this package refuses, so that "nothing was collected
# from here" is an assertion rather than an accident of what was lying around.
studio/.DS_Store              | 2026-03-04 06:44:00
studio/notes.db-wal           | 2026-03-04 06:45:00
.git/objects/ab/preview.png   | 2026-03-04 06:46:00
.venv/lib/site/thumbnail.png  | 2026-03-04 06:47:00
node_modules/kit/logo.png     | 2026-03-04 06:47:30
